goal: Allows Bitcoin Core wallet users to send transactions to BIP 352 silent payment addresses
Enables silent payment sends and RBF fee-bumping across send, sendtoaddress, sendmany, and sendall
reviewability: Needs rebase against master, but conflicts are mechanical and logic is ready for review
agreement: Strong support with multiple tested approvals and no open objections
Verified silent payment output compatibility against btclib-wallet across hundreds of sends (fametrano)
Tested key resolution in coin selection and verified contiguous fee-bumping behavior (Yudis-bit)
Concept approval without stated reasons (rkrux, w0xlt, rustaceanrob, polespinasa, davidgumberg)
Open suggestions for test refactoring, helper functions, and extra test coverage (rustaceanrob)
